qualification.caveat: 600-second qualification; terminal 330511 count includes warmup. This does not establish the agreed 2-hour rehearsal -> fresh-Lease 72-hour Soak -> capacity on the same data -> 30-minute recovery chain or natural cool/reheat qualification. The 96-hour bound applies only to the formal Lease lifetime. Final operator_stop is the bounded harness stop; local_step records clean/complete and operator_interrupted=false.

native_delay.classification: environment/package-repository metadata download latency; successful step, no test failure

limitations: Read-only candidate qualification, not a release publication receipt.
Cross-node 2000-QPS opt-in test was skipped; four default functional tests passed.
Self-chat permits verified duplicate transport deliveries; the receipt is not zero-duplicate delivery proof.

Ten-minute run does not establish the agreed 2-hour rehearsal -> fresh-Lease 72-hour Soak -> capacity on the same data -> 30-minute recovery chain or natural cold/reheat qualification (lifecycle candidates/completed both 0); 96 hours is only the formal Lease lifetime bound.
Native preview used temporary test keys and unsigned source preview packages; it is not signed stable publication or public exact-version APT/RPM client acceptance.
Successful normal-exit Linux SID cleanup does not establish SIGKILL/runner-loss cleanup guarantees.
Large artifacts were selectively read through authenticated ZIP member ranges with CRC; API-declared full archive digests were not independently recomputed.
